cases.note: creates a board and its columns, and links each column under it

makeBoard.description: A board and a column under it for each column given.

cases.note: the same invocation with the columns reordered: every record gets the id it got in create-and-link

makeBoard.description: A board and a column under it for each column given.

cases.note: a find that matches skips the guarded create, and the operation returns what it found

ensureTag.description: The tag with this slug, made when there is none.

cases.note: a find that matches nothing lets the guarded create run, and the operation returns what it made

ensureTag.description: The tag with this slug, made when there is none.

cases.note: a failed check fails the operation with its named error, and the record made before it does not land

guarded.description: Makes a note, checks, and makes another — so a failed check must take the first back.

cases.note: a write to a record created earlier in the same operation lands on it

writeTwice.description: Makes a note and retitles it in the same operation.

cases.note: a strict link to a record already linked fails as alreadyLinked and changes nothing

adopt.description: Puts a record under another, strictly: refused when it is there already.

cases.note: core.upsertSignal with no reaction yet makes one under the record, and answers with its id

upsertSignal.description: Give the invoker’s reaction of one type on a record, or change it: one per person per type, edited in place, any duplicates removed.

value.description: What the reaction says. Zero is a value like any other; withdrawing is withdrawSignal.

cases.note: core.respond removes the answer the invoker gave before, on this record only, and makes the new one

respond.description: Give the invoker’s own answer to a record — going, maybe, not going — replacing any answer they gave before; with no kind, withdraw it.

kind.description: A reflexive InvolvementType’s slug; absent withdraws the answer.

errors.notAnAnswer: That is not an answer anybody can give to this.

in.$: held.filter(r, (r.node == node || node in r.node) && r.kind != kind)

when.$: kind && !held.exists(r, (r.node == node || node in r.node) && r.kind == kind)

cases.note: core.createPost as a reply: in its subject’s responses and thread, a child of nothing, its block under it

createPost.description: Write a composed document — a post, a message or a reply — with its blocks, in a collection or in response to a record, threaded under its subject.

root.description: The root’s own fields: kind, mode, and what it stores about its blocks (editorState, textContent), plus where a copy came from.

blocks.description: The blocks in document order, each { key, entity, fields, parent } — parent the planned id of the collection block it is in, absent at the top level.

container.description: The collection it is a child of.

thread.description: The subject of the thread it joins — respondsTo, or the first record above it that is not itself a response.

generatedBy.description: The ModelRun that wrote it, when a model did.

errors.twoPlaces: A post goes in a collection or answers a record, not both.

fields.$: generatedBy ? merge(root, { mentions: mentions ?? [], generatedBy: [generatedBy] }) : merge(root, { mentions: mentions ?? [] })

cases.note: core.moveCard leaves one column, joins the other where it was dropped, and takes a bound column’s state

moveCard.description: Move a card from one column to another, in one transaction: it leaves the first, joins the second (where it was dropped, or at the end), and takes the second’s state when that column is bound to one.

ids.description: The joined column’s order with the card where it was dropped. Omit to append.

cases.note: core.removeBoardColumn hands the column’s cards to the board and deletes the column, never a card

removeBoardColumn.description: Take a column off a board — never the work in it: its cards move to the board’s own arrangement, so a made board keeps them.

cases.note: core.placeCard edits the placement a canvas draws, removes the duplicate it outranks, and answers with what it held

placeCard.description: Write where a card sits on a canvas, or how it looks there: the placement the canvas draws is edited, or one made where there is none, and duplicates beside it removed. Answers { from, to } — what the fields held before — for an undo.

nodeType.description: Its entity, for a placement made here.

fields.description: Placement fields — x and y, a size, a colour, a rank …

placement.description: The placement the canvas draws for the card, where it has one.

duplicates.description: Placements of the card the drawn one outranks, to remove.

create.description: Whether a card with no placement may be given one. False for a style, which needs a position.

errors.notPlaced: Drag this onto the canvas first — how a card looks is saved with where it sits.
